questions.answer: MA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: There was a big difference between my courses. I followed courses closely linked to my direction at KU but also courses in another direction.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: A experienced a lot of group work, which I am not used to at KU.

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer:
Tools in Molecular Data Analysis
Human Environment Interaction
Scientific Programming 1
Biogeochemical cycles in System Earth
Change Making: Co-creating healthy future(s)

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Human Environment Interaction - it is a very intensive course but you really learn a lot. Tools in Molecular Data Analysis is also intense but if you want to become better at analyzing data, then it is a very nice course.
